title: How Cardinals Eat, Sleep & Vote While Locked In to Choose a Pope
intro: 133 cardinals, no phones, no news, and they can't leave until they agree on one name. Here's how cardinals eat, sleep and vote inside a papal conclave, using the May 2025 conclave as the example.
asof_line: Rules from Universi Dominici Gregis (1996); details of the May 2025 conclave as reported at the time.
